repos_data.description: Financial Markets Data Visualization using Matplotlib

Rust crate of validated, decimal-precise trading building blocks: price types, L2 order book, tick-to-OHLCV aggregation, hundreds of streaming indicators, position ledger, risk rules, Black-Scholes Greeks and a walk-forward backtester. On crates.io.

C++20 research implementation of special-relativistic geometry on OHLCV market data: Lorentz factors, spacetime-interval regime labels, Christoffel symbols and geodesic-deviation signals, with SIMD kernels, Python validation scripts and a LaTeX paper.

Rust streaming primitives for real-time market data: exchange tick normalization (Binance, Coinbase, Alpaca, Polygon), WebSocket reconnect, lock-free SPSC ring buffer, OHLCV bars, order books, feed health and microstructure analytics (OFI, VPIN). On crates.io.
